CREATE TABLE listhash(
       key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
       id TEXT,
       node INTEGER
     )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ididx ON listhash(id)
SELECT node FROM listhash WHERE id='5000' LIMIT 1
SELECT node FROM listhash WHERE id="5000" LIMIT 1
SELECT node FROM listhash WHERE id=5000 LIMIT 1
SELECT node FROM listhash WHERE id=[5000] LIMIT 1
